name: Inward Fist
description: Throw a fist that draws the foe's own weight toward the point of impact.

name: Gathering Bulwark
description: Gather loose weight into a wall before the user that thickens with every blow it takes.

name: Falling Inward
description: Step toward a heavy body as though falling to it and arrive at once at its edge.

name: Density Sense
description: Tell by feel which body in a scene holds the most mass and where it presses hardest.

name: Pinch Point
description: Pinch all the weight of a blow to a single point that pierces a dense guard.

name: Drawing Chain
description: Chain foes together by pull until each drags on the next and none can step free.

name: Storing Shell
description: Take the weight of a blow into a hollow shell of qi and hold it for later release.

name: Gravity Well
description: Open a well of pull that drags every foe near it toward one point and holds them there.

name: Star Crush
description: Fold the well in on itself so that all it has gathered is crushed together.

name: Collapse Core
description: Drive all nearby weight into one collapsing core that crushes foes and pins those who survive.

name: Twofold Palm
description: Strike a palm doubled in weight into the chest and double it again as it lands.

name: Dense Plate
description: Raise a plate of qi doubled in mass that stops a strike without budging.

name: Quaking Tread
description: Tread so heavily that the ground beneath the foe shakes and its footing is lost.

name: Fourfold Fist
description: Throw a fist multiplied fourfold in weight that smashes through the guard of a lesser fighter.

name: Sagging Limbs
description: Multiply the weight of a foe's limbs until arms and legs hang too heavy to move.

name: Light Self
description: Take all weight off the user's own body for a few breaths and move beyond ordinary speed.

name: Eightfold Burden
description: Heap eightfold weight on one foe so that it falls to the ground and cannot rise.

name: Heavy Wave
description: Send a wave of redoubled weight through the ground to flatten foes in a wide ring.

name: Mass Redoubled
description: Redouble weight upon one great foe until it falls beneath its own body and cannot lift a hand.

name: Anchor Fist
description: Hit the foe's chest and fix an anchor of qi in its body that holds it near.

name: Sunk Root
description: Send roots of weight deep into the ground so no force can move the user.

name: Hauling Step
description: Haul the user's weight forward on a line of pull from a fixed anchor.

name: Anchor Reading
description: Read where every anchor of the user's has been set and how firmly it holds.

name: Safe Mooring
description: Moor an ally to the user so that no blow or throw can carry them away.

name: Foe Mooring
description: Moor a foe to its own shadow so that it cannot take a single step away.

name: Moored Chain
description: Seal a foe's leaping technique by dropping a chained anchor on its path.

name: Drag Down
description: Hit a foe while dragging its footing earthward so it falls at the moment of the blow.

name: Fleet Anchor
description: Cast a swift anchor to the earth that holds the user's guard through a long flurry.

name: Unmovable Rock
description: Become so deeply anchored that no technique can shift the user a pace.

name: Fastening Law
description: Fasten a foe's body to the ground so that it cannot move any limb while the seal stands.

name: Great Anchor
description: Drop the great anchor so foes in range cannot flee while allies behind the user stay safe.

name: Plummet Fist
description: Drive a fist downward with the pull of a long fall behind it.

name: Canopy Guard
description: Spread a canopy of dense qi overhead that takes falling weight and sheds it.

name: Plunging Step
description: Leap and plunge at an angle to land beside the foe with the full weight of the fall.

name: Fall Gauge
description: Judge the height and weight of a falling thing and where it will strike.

name: Catch Fall
description: Catch the fall of an ally in a cushion of slow pull so that the landing is soft.

name: Flung Mass
description: Hurl a heavy block with gravity qi and let its descent double the strike.

name: Squeezing Fall
description: Hold a falling mass above a foe in place so that any step brings it lower.

name: Landing Shock
description: Land from a height and send the shock of the fall out round the user.

name: Crushing Slab
description: Call a slab of weight down upon one foe with the force of a falling wall.

name: Avalanche Weight
description: Pour a slide of crushing weight down over a wide slope of ground and all upon it.

name: Descent Absolute
description: Bring the whole mass of the descent down at once on a chosen point and crush all there.

name: Reversed Palm
description: Strike with a palm that turns the pull upward under the target so it lifts and then drops.

name: Upward Guard
description: Lift an attacking limb with a reversed pull so the blow passes over the user's head.

name: Inverted Hop
description: Rise in a short hop on a reversed pull and land past the foe's reach.

name: Lifted Foe
description: Lift a foe off the ground by reversing the pull beneath it so it flails in the air.

name: Sudden Return
description: Restore the pull on a lifted foe at once so it drops hard onto the ground.

name: Light Burden
description: Reverse the pull on an ally's pack and armour so that they move as if unburdened.

name: Inversion Pull
description: Invert the pull across a field so every foe within it rises and cannot plant a foot.

name: Rain Upward
description: Throw loose stones upward and invert the pull so they rain back at triple their weight.

name: Reversed Law
description: Reverse the law of weight over a wide space so foes are lifted helpless and then thrown to the ground.

name: Ringed Palm
description: Strike a palm that sets the target spinning in a small orbit around the user.

name: Curving Guard
description: Curve a blow in a wide arc around the user so it passes on and spends itself.

name: Circuit Step
description: Pace in a tight circuit around the foe so it keeps turning to face the user.

name: Orbit Reading
description: Read the paths of every body orbiting the user's centre and when each will pass.

name: Spare Stones
description: Keep a ring of small stones turning about the user and snap one outward at a foe.

name: Tightening Orbit
description: Draw a foe into an orbit that tightens with every circuit until it must stop moving.

name: Slingshot Turn
description: Whip a captured foe round the user's centre and let go so it flies into the nearest wall.

name: Ring of Guard
description: Set a ring of turning stones about the user that intercepts every blow that nears.

name: Orbiting Mass
description: Set a small mass turning round an ally so it smooths their motion and guards their side.

name: Orbit Rings
description: Draw many foes into rings round the user and bind each to its path.

name: Comet Strike
description: Hurl a foe from its orbit straight at another with the speed of a comet's fall.

name: Celestial Sweep
description: Swing all bound orbits outward in a great sweep that smashes everything caught.

name: Orbit Total
description: Bind all within range to orbits of the user's making and then bring each in to crush.

name: Slow Weight
description: Strike a palm that leaves a slow-growing weight in the foe's chest.

name: Stilled Weight
description: Settle into a guard of such weight that the first blow only locks it more firmly.

name: Sure Footing
description: Move only to ground that the weight has already tested and found sound.

name: Gathering Doom
description: Feel the weight gathering on a foe and judge how many breaths remain before it falls.

name: Creeping Weight
description: Add a little weight to a foe each breath so it tires faster and cannot recover.

name: Heavy Heart
description: Press on the foe's chest from inside until its breath comes short and its qi sags.

name: Lasting Press
description: Set a press on a foe's body that does not lift when the user steps away.

name: Settling Doom
description: Let a doom of added weight settle on a foe that grows until it can no longer stand.

name: Long Burden
description: Cash in all the weight laid on a foe in one heavy blow that finishes it.

name: Weight Unending
description: Lay a weight on one great foe that never stops growing until it cannot lift a finger.

name: Low Ceiling
description: Press the air low over the user's head so aerial strikes lose their reach.

name: Air Palm
description: Strike with a palm that lays the weight of the air on the target all at once.

name: Grounded Pace
description: Move along the ground in swift low paces beneath the pressed air.

name: Flier Sense
description: Sense anything that flies or leaps within range by how it strains against the pressed air.

name: Cloud Press
description: Drive a mass of pressed air down on a distant foe like a falling cloud.

name: Wing Weight
description: Weigh down a flier's wings or a leaper's legs so it falls out of its flight.

name: Dragging Slam
description: Slam a dragged-down foe against the ground with the added weight of the air.

name: No Leap
description: Seal a foe's legs so no leap or jump technique can be performed for a short time.

name: Pressed Heaven
description: Press the whole air down so that nothing within the area can fly or leap.

name: Downpour of Weight
description: Rain weight from the pressed air onto an area so that it crushes everything standing in it.

name: Sky Lowered
description: Lower the whole sky onto a wide field so all within it are pinned and crushed to the ground.
